Initial release of AfrexAI Budget & Expense Tracker — conversational budgeting and wealth-building tool.

- Log expenses, income, and refunds naturally; data stored in a local JSON ledger.
- Enforce customizable budgets by category and subcategory with real-time alerts (warning/critical/overbudget/unusual spend).
- Track recurring transactions and apply them automatically.
- Manage and monitor savings goals with projections and surplus recommendations.
- Generate weekly, monthly, and year-to-date reports with actionable insights and pace tracking.
